scope_analysis.interpretation: Original backend<=4 checks are retained, including failures. Proxy<=4 applies to active proxy request lifetimes, not canceled remote handlers still cleaning up. SQL pool stays4. Middleware reference counts actual protected handler lifetime. Post-hoc classification is not all-predeclared-criteria-pass evidence.

methodology.traffic: Open-loop, no retries, 80% critical except background-flood20%, independent60/20/20 orders/catalog/inventory mix.100ms useful-work budget for both priorities includes scheduling+network+queue+handler. SQL delay/failure injection per admitted transaction; everyNth errors are not identical requests across policies. Each phase fully drains before next; controller/token state survives; next phase has no artificial cooldown.
methodology.fairness: All policies share three service processes, PostgreSQL image, pool sizes, deadlines, route handlers and offered schedule. Semaphore and fixed-unreserved isolate a classless concurrency ceiling. Other Gatewise cases reserve1of4 for critical. Rate limits are per service, classless and do not cap active work;100/300/900 rates predeclared, burst4. Proxy cases add a fourth process and hop and are reported as deployment outcomes, not isolated policy-speed comparisons. The direct/rate cases deliberately have no HTTP concurrency cap. Other Gatewise features off.
methodology.selection: Exploratory runs revealed the need for a background-heavy phase; they are excluded. Rates, cases, revised workload and integrity criteria fixed before this subsequent confirmatory matrix; no win gate. Fresh databases each run; rotating case order each repeat. Single local host, no production capacity claim.

aggregation: Each throughput and successful p95 is the median of three run-level values. Whiskers show min/max repeats, not confidence intervals. Rejection, server error and deadline percentages pool counts. Both priorities use100ms whole-schedule useful-work budget. Successful p95 excludes refusals/errors. Queue p95 includes successful immediate admissions with zero wait. Pool waits are real database/sql deltas shared by all priorities of a service; never attributable to one priority. All-service pool waits sum3services. Recovery is end of first whole1s bin meeting90% timely/offered critical work and retaining it through3s recovery; null if not attained in all repeats. Proxy adds a hop; rate/direct do not cap active work. The original protocol verdict and all backend-bound failures remain in scope_analysis. Post-hoc lifetime classification distinguishes proxy admission from canceled remote work. Measurement validation is not all-original-criteria-pass evidence or an advantage claim.
harness: examples/commerce/comparison_recorded.py (byte-identical measured collection protocol); comparison_benchmark.py adds explicit post-hoc analysis. The default comparison_protocol.py changes hardware metadata portability only, not workload or collection logic.
overhead: commerce-backend/tests/baseline/baseline_test.go, BenchmarkSuccessfulHandler; sequential no-op, observer present in all cases, pre-created request/writer, empty body, no network/SQL/contention/actual queue waiting. Rate1e15 avoids refusals. Adaptive stable profile. Enabled queue tests immediate admission only.
